papers.name: PowerAgentBench-Dyn
papers.status: Prototype research benchmark; not a deployed utility agent
papers.concept: Constrained iterative dynamic-model diagnosis and repair.

tool_roles.agent: Select tests, inspect feedback and edit only permitted gains
tool_roles.guard: Four REECAU1 gains whitelisted; all other model fields locked

evaluation.success_definition: Full test suite passes within budget with action-space compliance

secondary_task.name: Dynamic Security Risk Screening
secondary_task.caution: Different task and Opus version. Failures include simulator-tool execution; do not pool with DMQ.

limits: One corrupted model and small repeated sample do not establish fleet generalization.
No matched human or deterministic search baseline.
Dynamic harness requires licensed PSS/E plus external DMView.
No utility operating or model-approval authority established.

figure_possibilities.purpose: Redraw measured compliant-session counts and median updates

teaching_slides: Identify an allowed parameter space before changing a dynamic model.
Compare full-suite success with iteration efficiency and compliance.

papers.name: PowerBench (power-system retrieval)
papers.status: Synthetic benchmark research; not confidential utility data or control deployment
papers.concept: Resolve device clues, retrieve linked records, compute over telemetry and return evidence-backed structured answers.

tool_roles.solver: No grid power-flow solver is the focus; executable rules generate and check answers.

evaluation.primary_metric: Macro-JA: equal average of family-level complete-answer accuracy
evaluation.secondary_metric: Overall FA: mean per-question fraction of correct fields
evaluation.success_definition: Schema-valid answer with every required answer field correct
evaluation.intervals: Author-reported 95% bootstrap intervals, preserved exactly; no new intervals computed.
evaluation.locator: Table4, PDF p.8; definitions §4.1 and AppendixD

trace_metrics.example: For DeepSeek-V4-Pro on TRR, 96.61% retrieved-evidence recall and 95.72% available-evidence recall accompany 50.0% joint accuracy.

limits: Macro-JA is not a correct-count divided by300.
Field accuracy gives partial credit and is not full-task success.
No physical-grid safety or power-flow feasibility claim.
Public project listing currently shows only README and LICENSE; runnable data/harness release not verified.
Do not infer statistical significance merely from overlapping marginal intervals.

figure_possibilities.purpose: Shared dependency chain behind synthetic evidence
Redraw reported accuracy with author intervals

teaching_slides: Follow evidence across device metadata, documents and telemetry.
Distinguish complete answers, partial field credit and evidence retrieval.

papers.name: GridMind weather-risk workflow
papers.status: Research simulation on synthetic Texas2000; not a utility deployment
papers.concept: Content-hashed artifacts determine which computational stages remain reusable after a follow-up query.

evaluation.baseline: Each identical query executed in a fresh namespace

papers.dependency_detail: Q4 reruns ACOPF only: contingency consumes outage schedules directly in this implementation, not ACOPF output. Q5 changes upstream weather and reruns all five stages.
limits: Single reported session/ablation; no repeated-session confidence interval.
60% fewer stages is not60% less wall time.
Neural screening and reduced-order cascades need validation against utility-grade models.
Artifact hashes establish identity, not correctness or freshness beyond declared inputs.
Runnable GridMind source release not verified; project organization links related LUMINA software.

figure_possibilities.purpose: Draw the seven-query reuse pattern and measured ablation

teaching_slides: Predict invalidation when scope, solver or forecast changes.
Compare saved stage executions with measured session wall time.

papers.name: GridMind analysis prototype (2025)
papers.status: Earlier research prototype; optional comparison with2026 workflow
papers.concept: Specialized conversational agents invoke deterministic ACOPF and contingency tools.

tool_roles.context: Typed shared state and cached numerical artifacts

evaluation.acopf: Figure3 reports100% success on case118; execution-time distribution uses five repetitions. Do not invent broader success counts.

limits: ACOPF reference-solver agreement does not validate contingency-search completeness.
The paper does not provide exhaustive contingency ground truth or repeated counts for Table1.
Do not treat inter-model agreement as a correctness proof.
2025 PydanticAI implementation must not be relabeled as the2026 LangGraph workflow.

figure_possibilities.purpose: Reported narrow-task success and latency comparison

teaching_slides: A solver-grounded answer can still have incomplete coverage.
Ask what the reference answer checks and what remains untested.

excluded_leads.title: Grid-Agent: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent System for Power Grid Control
